name: Monotonic Projected Minimum Teaching Set Size of Singletons
proof: The class itself is an admissible subfamily, and its minimum projected teaching-set size is $n-1$, so the monotonic projected value is at least $n-1$. Conversely, every subfamily of the singleton class has at most $n$ concepts. For a subfamily with $m\geq2$ singleton traces, projecting away the target coordinate shows that its minimum projected teaching-set size is at most $m-1\leq n-1$; one-concept subfamilies have value zero. Taking the maximum over subfamilies gives exactly $n-1$.
